2698719.baseName: Habitat 6ft Slim Evergreen Christmas Tree - Green
2698719.variantName: Habitat 6ft Slim Evergreen Christmas Tree - Green
2698719.sourceDescription: Bring festive cheer to smaller spaces with this slim evergreen Christmas tree. It's designed with a compact footprint to fit where standard trees won't, making it ideal for flats, hallways or any room where space is at a premium. You're getting a tree with 465 tips and flat needles that create a realistic evergreen look without taking over your floor space. Setting it up is quick and simple - just slot the pieces together into the plastic stand and pull down the hinged branches. Once it's built, you can tweak and tease the branches to create that thick, full appearance, then decorate to your heart's content. The PVC construction means it's built for indoor use and comes with a plastic stand included. When the festivities are over, it packs back into its box for easy storage, ready to bring the magic next Christmas. . Always supervise children near this decoration.

wdtk5ztb.variantName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Ultra Devonshire Fir - Warm White/Multi-Colour Lights
wdtk5ztb.sourceDescription: Our most popular pre-lit Christmas tree, the 10ft Ultra Devonshire Fir tree combines stunning realism with a wonderful lighting display. There's no need to untangle any Christmas lights yourself with this one. Just click the button on the controller box to soften your tree with a warm white or go kaleidoscopic with the multicoloured option - the lighting choice is all yours! There are 8 different lighting functions, including the classic 'always on' as well as the unique flashing function that effortlessly mixes both colours together. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included. f05agqbf.baseName: Walplus 150 Warm LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
f05agqbf.variantName: Walplus 150 Warm LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
f05agqbf.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 95 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Number of PVC tips: 340 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

w0qeb577.baseName: Charles Bentley 55cm Red Bow & Bells Artificial Christmas Wreath - Green
w0qeb577.variantName: Charles Bentley 55cm Red Bow & Bells Artificial Christmas Wreath - Green
w0qeb577.sourceDescription: Our 55cm Christmas Wreath with Red Bow & Bells delivers a classic festive display that works on any front door, wall, or interior space. The rich green circular foliage base is finished with a bold red bow and decorative bells, a traditional combination that's instantly evocative of Christmas. The full, dense foliage gives the wreath a well-dressed, substantial feel, and the classic detailing means it pairs naturally with any Christmas colour scheme – red and gold, traditional green and silver, and more. At 55cm in diameter, it's a generous size that suits a standard front door without overwhelming it. Lightweight and easy to hang, it requires no tools or assembly – just unpack, shape if needed, and display. Ideal for: Front doors, interior walls, above fireplaces, staircase posts, and festive window displays. Please Note: Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Features: • Bold red bow and decorative bells add instant festive character • Rich dense green foliage base for a full well-dressed appearance from every angle • Works equally well on front doors interior walls above mantels or on staircase posts • Pliable branches that can be lightly shaped for a fuller more natural look • Durable plastic construction – no needle drop no mess colour-fast season after season • Lightweight and easy to hang – no tools or assembly required • Compact to store flat between seasons Includes: • 1x Christmas Wreath with Red Bow & Bells Materials: • Plastic (foliage) • Fabric (bow) • Metal (bells) Weights: • 1.8kg Colours: • Green with red bow and metallic bell accents Additional Info: • Styling: Hang on a front door with a simple hook or loop. Works indoors above a fireplace or on a feature wall. • Construction: Durable plastic foliage with fabric bow and decorative bell detailing – designed to hold its shape and colour across multiple festive seasons. • Storage: Store flat in a cool dry place between seasons. Reshape branches lightly each year for best results. • Care: Wipe foliage with a dry or lightly damp cloth to remove dust. Do not expose to open flame or excessive heat. Dimensions: H3.5, W55, D55cm Warning: decorative item, not a toy. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and ignition sources. Hang securely so it cannot fall. Keep small decorative parts, ribbons and bells away from young children and pets to reduce choking or entanglement risk. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ

r7cfz5v6.variantName: Indoor Outdoor 55cm Pre-Lit White Berry & Pinecone Eucalyptus Wreath
r7cfz5v6.sourceDescription: Welcome guests in festive style with our indoor outdoor 60cm pre-lit white berry & pinecone eucalyptus wreath, a timeless Christmas classic perfect for any front door or festive display. Lightly dusted with a snowy finish, and adorned with white berries & pinecones, our pre-lit wreath brings a touch of winter wonder to any space. Warm white Micro LED lights are woven throughout the frosted greenery, casting a soft, magical glow that's perfect for creating a cosy, inviting atmosphere. Battery powered for easy placement, this wreath is ideal for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use – decorate doors, windows, mantels, or walls with ease. Whether you're refreshing your holiday décor or starting a new tradition, this elegant wreath is designed to bring festive charm to your home year after year. Please Note: The branches may need to be fanned out by hand after assembly to achieve the desired look. Features: • Micro LED Lights • Battery Powered • Indoor and Outdoor Use • 50 Timer Bulbs Includes: • 1x 55cm Pre-Lit Wreath Materials: • Plastic Dimensions: H55, W55, D20cm Not for children under 3 years Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ
